svg.title: JavaScript First (2026) — High School CTE & Community College Curriculum Roadmap
svg.desc: Full 21-unit, 49-lesson visual roadmap spanning Year 1 (CTE/CIS 101, CTE/CIS 102) and Year 2 (CTE/CIS 201, CTE/CIS 202), integrating Software and App Design (11.0202.00) with AI (11.0102.00), IT Security (11.1999.00), and a Hands-On Drone Build Capstone (49.0199.00) with external FAA portals, TDD auto-grading, and 75%+ 8-cert aligned 50-question mastery exams.
